newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest shares seen steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: Budapest shares seen steady to higher.

text.p: Hungarian shares were seen moving sideways or higher on Friday, traders said.
Peter Nagy of Postabank Securities said Hungarian stocks would need a temporary halt before moving to higher territory.
"The market needs a break so it can rise further," he said.
He added that oil company MOL, which has recently released some details of its May IPO, would remain in focus, accompanied by chemicals TVK.
Another trader said the rising turnover of the last days showed that foreign investors were back and that was likely to push prices higher on Friday.
"I expect the rise to continue today with TVK, OTP Bank and (hotelier) Danubius in focus," said Gabor Temesvari of Porcent Hungaria.
On Thursday the BUX index finished at 5,662.39 points, up 94.48.
